title: Kiss Kis Ko
desc: A group of young Indian men calling themselves Band of Boys decide to perform publicly, to share their talents India-wide, as well as to make a career for themselves. It seems the public is only interested seeing a group of girls perform.

title: Omerta
desc: Omerta (2018) is a gripping biographical thriller about Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British-born terrorist involved in kidnappings and the murder of journalist Daniel Pearl.

title: Ki & Ka
desc: Kia, an ambitious woman, marries Kabir, a man who prefers the role of a house husband. They enjoy their unconventional relationship until challenges, including ego clashes and jealousy set in.

title: Badal
desc: Badal witnesses his family being massacred during a riot in his village. He is raised by a terrorist and soon sets out to exact revenge on the police officer responsible for his family's murder.

title: Kisaan
desc: The story of a farmer, Maan Singh, who struggles to save his ancestral land from corrupt officials and greedy businessmen. With the help of his son, he fights against the system and stands up for his rights as a farmer. The movie highlights the challenges faced by farmers in modern India and explores themes of family, tradition, and social justice in a poignant and inspiring plot.

title: Dharam Chakara (dharam Chakaram Tamil 1997)
desc: A village leader who loses a fight to his enemy Arumugam, causing the death of his lover Vijayalakshmi. Years later, another woman named Vijayalakshmi enters the village, and Chakkaravarthy defends her from Arumugam's goons, rekindling his fight for justice.
